# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2003

**Additional Appropriation for Medicines**

## Summary

This municipal ordinance appropriates funds from the [[2001]] Local Government Service Equalization Fund to purchase medicines for the Municipal Health Office of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. The ordinance allocates P693,985.00 for this purpose. The ordinance was enacted on [[October 13, 2003]].

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Appropriates P693,985.00 from the [[2001]] Local Government Service Equalization Fund for the purchase of medicines at the Municipal Health Office, [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  **Section 2.** The additional appropriation is based on the recommendation in "Annex A" of the Kagawarang Laang-Gugulin Blg. 03, Serye ng Taong [[2003]].
3.  **Section 3.** The ordinance for additional appropriation will take effect upon its approval.
4.  **Section 4.** Approved on [[October 13, 2003]] in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
